articles.title: Lampsy Health raises €1.1M to shine a light on undetected night-time seizures
Lampsy raises €1.1M to take its seizure-detecting lamp to Europe and UK
Lisbon's Lampsy Health raises €1.1 million for its AI bedside lamp that detects epileptic seizures during sleep

brief.essentiel: Lampsy Health has closed a €1.1 million funding round to finance the commercial launch and distribution of its product in Europe and the UK.
points: The smart lamp is embedded with a small built-in camera and a proprietary artificial intelligence algorithm.
The Portuguese startup has developed a lamp that monitors for epileptic seizures during sleep.
It detects movements that may indicate a seizure with over 97 per cent accuracy and automatically alerts emergency contacts.
A computer vision and AI system running on the device itself recognises the patterns associated with tonic-clonic seizures.

articles.title: EU-INC is in crisis but $1M-backed Shuttle isn’t waiting for Europe to fix cross-border fundraising
Shuttle raises $1M to let startups raise capital across EU and UK

brief.essentiel: Shuttle , an Irish fintech whose regulated platform allows investment syndicates and fund managers to raise and deploy capital across borders, has launched with authorisation from the Financial Conduct Authority alongside its existing Central Bank of Ireland authorisation.
points: Shuttle has raised $1 million to date to solve this problem, with investment coming from Baseline, Enterprise Ireland , and angel investors including the CEO of Revolut Holdings, the GM of Western Europe for ElevenLabs , and the VP EMEA at Astronomer.
Syndicate leads, fund managers and founders can now run deals on one platform, regulated in both the EU and the UK, and bring in investors from across Europe and the US.
The launch comes as uncertainty grows over EU Inc , the proposed “28th regime” designed to give European startups a single company structure.
Even if it passes, it only addresses where a company is registered, not how it raises money.

articles.title: WaterSense raises €5.75M to build Europe's water intelligence infrastructure
Warsaw-based WaterSense secures €5.75 million to make sense of Europe’s water using AI and satellite data

brief.essentiel: Water intelligence company WaterSense has secured €5.75 million in funding through a combination of grants and a pre-seed round co-led by b2venture and Movens Capital , with participation from vastpoint .
points: Founded by Filip Budny , WaterSense develops autonomous water quality monitoring technology that combines proprietary sensor hardware with an AI-powered platform to help industrial operators, utilities and public authorities monitor and manage water resources.
The new capital will support the expansion of its water monitoring infrastructure across Europe.
Water plays a critical role in industrial production, cooling systems, wastewater management and public infrastructure.
As water supplies become increasingly constrained, water security is also becoming a strategic priority for the European Union.

articles.title: Audun raises $3M to modernise debt collection with AI

brief.essentiel: Norwegian AI-native debt collection company Audun has raised $3 million in funding from Alliance VC , Y Combinator , Robinhood Ventures , Skyfall , First Degree and angel investors across Europe and the United States.
points: Founded by Peter Flo , Magnus Vonen , Jacob Hambro and Henrik Fevang , Audun aims to modernise the debt collection industry by integrating AI into traditionally manual processes.
The company's technology automates routine case handling, including responding to common questions and enquiries, allowing employees to focus on more complex cases that require human judgement.

Beyond automating case handling, Audun uses data and AI to help clients identify and address payment problems before they reach collections, shifting the focus towards prevention and early intervention.
This approach enables Audun to resolve claims faster and at lower costs while improving the experience for debtors.

articles.title: Belgian cyber insurance startup Inqase raises €1M

brief.essentiel: Belgian cyber insurance startup Inqase has raised €1 million in a funding round, it said today.
points: Inqase provides cyber insurance for SMEs, with its offering spanning insurance, with continuous risk monitoring and 24/7 incident response.
The funding round was led by Brussels-based VC ScaleFund, alongside invest.bw, with Seeder Fund and business angels, including Belgian serial entrepreneur Philippe Van Ophem also participating.
Its services are distributed through brokers, IT service providers and accounting firms.
Inqase, which launched this year, was founded by Rodolphe Lechat, Guillaume Deterville and Drilon Saraqini, who have previously built and sold companies.

articles.title: Beyond the taboo: Polari Labs brings biotech innovation to anorectal health

brief.essentiel: London-based biotech and sexual wellness startup Polari Labs has raised funding.
points: Founded in 2023, the company develops science-led consumer products for anorectal health, an area historically underserved by both medical research and commercial innovation.
Polari Labs has spent several years developing its flagship product, A-BALL, a single-use, patent-pending hydrogel insert designed to replace conventional anal douching.

The product aims to reduce preparation time for anal sex from around 20–30 minutes to 30 seconds, addressing the physical discomfort, anxiety and lack of spontaneity associated with conventional douching.
Polari Labs uses polymers already found in products such as suppositories and sexual lubricants, including gelatine and alginate.

articles.title: General Catalyst backs 17-year-old Austrian's quant trading startup

brief.essentiel: A 17-year-old Austrian International Mathematical Olympiad medallist has raised pre-seed funding led by General Catalyst for his quant trading startup looking to take on giants like Jane Street and Citadel.
points: Vienna-based VVS is run by four young founding partners, who hold various international Olympiad medals and have worked at top quant trading firms like Optiver.

VVS is building a ground-up quantitative research stack and trains its own machine learning models, as well as developing trading infrastructure, from market data to technology which minimises the delay between trading decisions and trades being carried out.
William Shi , 17, CEO and co-founder, says: “We’re focusing first on building the fundamentals in data, talent and infrastructure.

The funding round for an undisclosed amount also includes funding from Viet Le-Martin, a prominent European tech investor; Christoph Deckert, a former operator at German software unicorn Personio, and angel investors from Jump Trading, OpenAI and other leading quant and AI firms.

articles.title: Papa John’s pizza order first UK cardless payment by AI agent

brief.essentiel: An AI agent has paid for Papa John’s pizzas directly from a customer’s bank account via cardless payment technology in a trial, which the tech provider says is the first of its kind.
points: TrueLayer , the open banking tech provider, says it was the first time an AI agent had paid a UK retailer this way.
The pilot was part of the Financial Conduct Authority’s (FCA) AI regulatory sandbox trials, to test that an AI agent could make payments within limits agreed by the customer.
The trial comes amid AI agents expected to handle a growing share of online shopping.
The trial saw Papa John’s AI agent help the customer with their order, and then pay straight from the bank account the customer linked to their Papa John’s account.

articles.title: ARK Capture Solutions secures €5.4M to scale its all-electric carbon capture technology

brief.essentiel: The investment comes 20 months after the company's €2.2 million pre-seed round and marks its transition from pilot testing to industrial-scale deployment.
points: ARK also leads CO₂ DISRUPT, a €5.6 million project supported by the Walloon Region, in collaboration with Aperam, Industeel, Cinergie, UMONS and Certech.
Founded by Samuel Thiry and Aurélien Vantomme , ARK Capture Solutions focuses on developing more affordable and energy-efficient alternatives to conventional industrial carbon capture technologies.
The phase-out of free carbon allowances and rising CO₂ prices under the EU Emissions Trading System (ETS) are increasing demand for affordable carbon capture solutions.
Captured CO₂ can also be used in industrial production or, when derived from biogenic sources, permanently stored to generate carbon removals.

brief.essentiel: What if robots could charge while moving, without needing to align with a charging pad or plug into a cable?
points: I covered the company's €2.9 million funding round earlier this year, when I interviewed co-founder Marko Voutilainen at my office during a visit to Berlin.
Or you could simply walk into a room and have your laptop or mobile phone start charging automatically, wherever you placed it?

At Slush in Helsinki last week, I caught up with Harri Santamala, co-founder and CEO of Willo Technologies , and Nam Ha-Van, co-founder and CTO, and other team members for a fascinating demo of their wireless power tech.
Both our offices are housed in former industrial factories, although theirs are considerably more salubrious.

articles.title: From €10,000 to 6 million connected cars: The bootstrapped rise of Lithuania's OBDeleven

brief.essentiel: As cars become increasingly software-defined, owning a vehicle no longer necessarily means having full access to the technology that makes it function.
points: Proprietary diagnostic protocols, software restrictions and increasingly complex electronics have made it harder for everyday drivers to understand, customise and repair their vehicles independently.
In 2025, the company generated €19.2 million in revenue, representing 25 per cent year-on-year growth, and recorded a net profit of €3.17 million.
Lithuanian automotive technology company OBDeleven is building a business around changing that.

Originally established as Voltas IT, the bootstrapped company has expanded beyond automotive enthusiasts to target everyday drivers, positioning itself as a comprehensive digital car ownership platform.
